title: World Bloom — Searching for Sunken Shadows

meta.Outline: Mafuyu is now living with Kanade after running away, and all four members of Nightcord at 25:00 are working together again. As they each turn their thoughts to the future, something begins to shift in the Empty SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'm finished mixing it. I'll share it now...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Cool! Wait, Yuki, you were the one working on it...?!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yuki used to do all the mixing for us, so I'm thinking about having her take over again.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oh, right... You could only write lyrics after what happened to your synth, but you can do more now that you're at K's house.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Why not?
That should allow K to focus more on composing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <True! Alright, Yuki, I'm gonna give your mix a listen now!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Whoa, this sound...! I haven't heard anything like this in such a long time... It's so you, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah. It feels all cold and heavy, but it makes K's melody sound just that much warmer.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll start writing the lyrics for it now if that's okay...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Then, I'll get started too.
This might just be the inspiration I needed to draw something good.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I know what you mean!
It's just so much easier to come up with good ideas when we're all working together like this!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She's been making these pained expressions lately whenever she's writing any lyrics...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Some unpleasant memories may be going through her mind. I mean, between what happened with us and her mom...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <I was wondering how you were all doing.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Same old, same old!
Our latest song's ahead of schedule now thanks to Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Working with the others like this helps take my mind off things.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mafuyu still looks like she's in pain...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (Mafuyu came so close to breaking that time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (She does seem to be doing a little better now that she's getting to spend more time with Kanade and the others.)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (I know this situation can't last forever...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: (But I hope she can use this time to give herself a chance.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm still not ready to go home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
How are you physically?
I'll bring anything over that you need.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That's okay. I have everything I need... Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, if you don't mind looking after Mafuyu for a little while longer.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I'll come visit again next week, so let me know if anything changes.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Here you are, Mafuyu.
I made you some tea.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's umm... Bergamot.
According to Ms. Mochizuki, it's supposed to help calm your nerves.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I do feel a little better now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, no. It's alright, I don't mind. There's no need for you to apologize...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'll get back to work now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'm going to go visit my dad.
I'll be back in a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (If the melody here goes like this, then...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Stumbling over the string that's tangled around your foot...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I think that's him...
Right on time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'll step in to help if anything happens...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you.
My name is Kanade Yoisaki...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you, Ms. Yoisaki.
I'm Mafuyu Asahina's father.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: Thank you for looking after her these past few days. I really appreciate what you've done for her...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I apologize for not coming by sooner. Unfortunately, I was away on a business trip.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Mafuyu...!
Thank goodness. I was so worried.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
No, don't say that.
I feel so much better now that I've seen your face.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: So, your mother told me everything...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I can't condone what she did...
To think that she'd try to take your phone away.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: However, I'm sure she had your best interests in mind.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
We can discuss this further when we get home.
I'm sure we'll be able to figure something out after we sit down and talk it all out.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I don't want to go home.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Your mother is feeling much better now.
I've already had a chance to speak with her.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I really can't go back right now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I know I need to talk to Mom...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I can't go back to that place...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
It's okay, Mafuyu.
Just try to relax.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I still don't know what exactly happened, but it's clear that you need some time and space...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: As her parent, I feel ashamed for not realizing how much pain my own daughter was in until now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line: I know this is asking a lot of you, but would you mind if Mafuyu stayed here for a little while?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Not at all. She's more than welcome...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
Thank you very much...
I'll have Mafuyu's things and other daily necessities sent over soon.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Father
rows.Line:
I'll come visit again.
When you feel ready, would you mind telling me what happened...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (And for as long as I keep staying at Kanade's house...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I also have school and my exams to think about...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Mafuyu, please.
I was wrong, so... Let's go home and talk about this together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
U-Uhh... Do you need to lie down?
Let's move somewhere you can...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
It's okay...
I'll be fine in a second.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Were you thinking about your family just now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: K-KAITO, I don't think now's the best time to...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Mafuyu, you need to keep one thing in mind.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Do not run away from what you're feeling right now.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: You're going to need to embrace this pain and anguish in order to find the real you.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
It's coming from over there.
What do you think's going on...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
But where's it coming from...
It sounds a lot like one of Kanade's songs...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I want to go see...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
I'm finished here.
I've said what I needed to say.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I don't know.
I only discovered it just now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But it wasn't here before. Why did it appear now...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But it may have something to do with Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, it's Kanade's song...
I think it's coming from inside this lake.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (The water looks clear, but I can't see the bottom...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Regardless, Len's right. This is where it seems to be coming from...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In any case, the possibility remains that this lake was born out of Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So does that mean... This book came out of the lake because it has some sort of connection with Mafuyu's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (It's so beautiful, but I can't see anything... And yet, it looks like there's something beneath the surface...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: A study guide for medical school...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (If this place came from Mafuyu's feelings, then it might also have something to do with her mom.)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I... I don't ever want to return here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But I hope you discover the real reason someday.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm sure this place was created for a reason. And I have a feeling that something of value to you is hidden here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, less of this effect and more motion might give this part a bigger punch.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'll try animating that asset Ena sent me yesterday a little more and...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That should do it.
I'll try playing it from the beginning...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, not bad...!
I'll have Kanade and the others take a look at this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm so glad Mafuyu chose to run away...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I was so worried since it really seemed like the walls were closing in on her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So, I'm really glad what I said ended up helping her a little.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Unfortunately, running away doesn't do anything about solving the root cause of her problems...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I'm sure a lot of stuff's going through her mind right now...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And I need to start thinking about what's gonna happen moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (After all, I'm partly responsible for her running since I was the one who suggested it to her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What more can I do for her? I mean, I still haven't been able to deal with my own problems after running away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I should take a quick break...
My eyes are starting to hurt after staring at this screen for so long.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know! I can go see if that ribbon I found the other day looks good on Rin.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That should help take my mind off things...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mizuki? What are you doing here...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
I came looking for Rin.
Do you know where she is?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Rin's gone somewhere a bit far away.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, there's a new area in SEKAI now.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
You've got me curious now.
Maybe I should go check it out.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You're not acting like your usual self...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It isn't bothering me per se, but it is kinda bugging me...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, um... I was thinking about how relieved I am that Mafuyu decided to run away.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And she seems to be doing a lot better now that she's in Kanade's care.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, all of that made me realize that I need to keep supporting her. After all, I'm the one who said it's okay for her to run...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I don't really know what to do since I've never gone past this point...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, I don't know what you're supposed to do after you've made a run for it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Running is only a temporary solution, right?
You have to deal with your problems eventually.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I haven't actually done that yet...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's why I'm not really sure if there's anything more I can do for Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you don't know, then face them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: If you don't know what to do after running, then stop running and face your problems.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I know. That's easier said than done.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But if you truly do wish to help Mafuyu, then this may be the best time for you to do that.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By doing so, you may learn something new. It could be the very thing that she needs to hear.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Like what you told her the other day.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yeah, I was able to make that suggestion because of what I went through...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(So, now that we've both run...
If there is something new I can learn by actually facing my problems...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I've been asking so much of Ena...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's been waiting for me ever since that day...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I don't know if I'm really ready for this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I feel a little better now after talking to you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Stretch*
I feel so much better after talking to you, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Now, let's go check out this new area.
Wanna come with?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But I don't know where it is! What if I get lost?! Can you live with that?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
You won't get lost.
It's straight ahead this way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's still too vague!
Can't you come with me?! Pretty please!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: She doesn't care if I get lost.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Aww, come on!
You're really not coming with me?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm leaving you behind if you don't hurry it up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey! All you said was, “I'm going.”
I thought that meant you were headed somewhere else!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess this means you're nicer than you let on, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I guess this means you want to get left behind...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, hey! Wait for me!
C'mon, let's go together♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Cool...!
So this is the new area...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, that's what it seems to be.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm... It seems to go pretty far.
Do you think there's something waiting for us on the other side?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, can't you at least try to play along?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I thought you were looking for Rin...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I didn't know you were here, Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was so surprised when I heard the news!
This place just sprang up overnight, huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, what are you two reading...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh... A children's picture book.
It came out of the lake.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What? Wait, out of the lake?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Mafuyu's feelings manifest themselves in this SEKAI. I'm sure this lake is connected somehow.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And despite being very clear, it's too deep to see the bottom. Her feelings may be hiding somewhere down there...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then, does this picture book also mean something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
By the way, what's it about?
Can I read it with you guys?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Once upon a time, there was a little rabbit.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She lived a very happy life with her mommy rabbit and daddy rabbit.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, that's pretty cute...
I kinda want to animate these rabbits now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'd like to see that as well.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, then, maybe I'll do just that!
I'll get Ena to do all of the illustrations.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The little rabbit was a very nice girl.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She did her best to help others because seeing them smile made her very happy.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She also loved seeing her mommy and daddy smile, so she helped them as much as she could.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Whenever her mommy asked her to clean her room, she'd clean and clean and clean until it became spotless.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Whenever her daddy asked her to go buy something for him, she'd take her little basket and get whatever he needed as quickly as she could.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She also knew that studying lots and lots would make them proud. And so, she did.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “As time went on, the little rabbit learned to do many different things.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “She tried so hard that she started getting tired.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Even so she kept trying and trying because she knew that's what would make everybody happy.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “But then, she started to forget why she was working so hard and what she really wanted to do.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “Still, even when she was in pain and so tired that she had very little energy to keep going, she kept doing what she could for others.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “But trying and trying started to make her chest feel colder and colder. Until eventually, she couldn't keep going.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh...
Mizuki, look at the next page...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: “That was when the dog, hedgehog and cat came to save her.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The dog played warm-sounding music for her.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The hedgehog drew pictures of the rabbit going forward even when she was lost.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “And the cat said nice things to her.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The dog's music helped the rabbit open her eyes once more.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “The hedgehog's pictures helped her feel hopeful about the future.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “And the cat's words helped her escape the place where she had become trapped.”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “As sad and painful as it was to leave...”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: “With the help of the others, the rabbit was able to protect what mattered most to her.”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, the last pages are blank...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. That's pretty cool...
It's like an illustration of Mafuyu's current situation...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I guess it makes sense that we'd find this in Mafuyu's SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Which means...
This story may be based on Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'm glad this rabbit's friends were there for her when she really needed them...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I doubt she could've escaped without them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In this story, the dog used music, the hedgehog used art and the cat said nice things to her.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (So, does this mean what I said really helped...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm gonna see what I can do about dealing with my own problems.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I mean, I can't let cottontail here hog all the glory.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(We're doing stills of fruit today...
I should be fine since I've practiced drawing them at home.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was so bad when I first started coming here...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (My perspective was all messed up, my lines were all crooked... I knew what I was going to be told.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Compared to then, I feeling like I'm doing a lot better now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (All I've done so far is sort of make up for lost time. The others are still miles ahead of me.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I just need to keep drawing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (One piece at a time without cutting any corners. I need to keep finding ways to get better.)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I came to take a look the other day when she was having trouble with what she was drawing...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <She always looked like she was in pain whenever she was drawing anything...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(He bit my head off again today...
To be fair, that's a pretty normal occurrence now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I feel like he's been making comments about the finer details lately...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Not too long ago, he'd usually just say that I need to draw everything again from scratch...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Nice work today!
Are you free after this?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: I was hoping that on the way home, we could go to this really yummy cheesecake shop that I found.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm gonna have to say yes to that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I think so. Let's stick around to see what happens.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: These fruits make it look gorgeous, and the cheese is so rich too. My mouth is in heaven right now...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Thanks for bringing me here, Futaba!

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: No, I've been meaning to invite you for a little while now. I'm so glad that you could come today!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You're that glad? Well, it does make me happy to hear that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Still, this reminds me of how we used to come to places like this.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Yeah!
Class always seems to end just in time when you start feeling hungry for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Mr. Yukihira's a harsh critic...
But I was always able to keeping returning because I was excited to go somewhere with you after class.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, his classes has always felt like a pressure cooker. And these places helped us unwind.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Exactly! But things might start getting even more tense moving forward...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: The ones trying to get into art school are probably going to start practicing even harder...

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: And I feel like I need to do the same.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: So, Ena, where do you want to go for university?

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Yeah, because I really like your art...
I feel that it'd be a huge shame if you didn't try to get accepted somewhere.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I still can't really see myself getting accepted into one.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, I want to go. I want to keep studying art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But the current me still doesn't have what it takes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I wasn't able to commit to my art before. Yeah, I'm back in class now, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (How am I supposed to get accepted anywhere? I know I have to get a lot better in order to...)

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Oh, Ena, I'm sorry...
Were you still undecided?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, umm... Yeah, kinda.
Or rather, I haven't had time to think about that lately.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Anyway, let's get another dessert!
This seasonal cake looks way too good.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line:
Hehe. Okay.
Then, let's get it.

rows.Speaker: Futaba
rows.Line: Excuse me. We'd like to make an order.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(She has a point...
I really do need to start thinking about my future...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I still don't have the skills nor the commitment...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm struggling to keep up with the others in class, and my illustrations still aren't doing N25's songs justice.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (As much as I want to become an artist, I doubt I'll be able to at this rate.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (So, how am I supposed to get into art school like the others...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh...? What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <We came to see how you were doing.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, um... We just wanted to see you while you drew again is all.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Really?
I doubt I was able to put on much of a show for you guys...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's what we thought when we saw you drawing earlier. You had such a serious look on your face.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, I was being serious. Everyone around me was also...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's not what I mean. The girl I saw before looked like she was in pain whenever she drew.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You drew as you struggled through that pain...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You were facing your art head on.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You have the strength to face that pain now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Thanks.
I really appreciate you always looking out for me...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: That means I need to start doing better...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Something crossed my mind just now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I want to keep drawing...
But is it really okay for me to?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So... I'm better now compared to before, but I'm nowhere near the level of Futaba and the others. Plus, my illustrations still aren't doing N25's songs justice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Which is why I'm wondering if it's really okay for me to try to go where they're going, to study art and to work towards the same goal...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I can't help you there... But seeing you tells me that what you're going through is a lot harder than I realize.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <But this also isn't like you, Ena...>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The Ena I know wouldn't be questioning whether or not you belong or whatever. She'd keep drawing no matter what.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Am I really that much of a musclehead...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Still, you're right...
I have to keep drawing if I wanna get better.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Then, Ena...
Um... Wanna try drawing us?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Y-Yeah. Remember how you were able to figure out something when you drew Mafuyu that one time?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <So, I thought you drawing us might help you in the same way.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thanks.
Then, I'll try doing a quick sketch of you two.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
So, where should we do this?
Would SEKAI be best if you two are gonna model for me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <In that case, why don't we go over there...?>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Oh, right...
That could be really good practice for Ena...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, where is this place you guys are talking about? I'm still totally in the dark.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <We'll be waiting for you in SEKAI...!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Whoa, what is this place...?
Has it always been here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a new area that appeared the other day.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You said how you always have trouble drawing water that one time, so we thought it might be good practice.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I did tell you guys that.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Then, I'll do my sketch here.
I agree that it'll be good practice since it feels pretty strange and mysterious.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Would you guys mind placing yourselves a little closer to the water for me? Feel free to pose however you like.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: How ever we like? That doesn't really help.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, this place is giving off some strange vibes...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I mean, it just appeared out of thin air?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (A lot has been going through Mafuyu's mind after what happened with her mom...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This place appearing probably means she's feeling something different now.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Nothing's wrong.
More importantly, stay still!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It's your fault for keeping us waiting.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Isn't this one of Kanade's songs...?
It sounds like it's coming from the lake...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Oh, right...
That's been happening every now and again.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, so it's really coming from within the lake? But why? How's that possible...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Unless something's down there.
Maybe a music player...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ena, it isn't safe for you to walk in.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I could've sworn that I just saw one of my drawings down there just now.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
One of your drawings...?
I don't see anything.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It was only for a split second. It looked like...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm gonna see if I can...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Nope. I can't seem to grab a hold of anything...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... I swear I saw it.
Or it was just my imagination.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What was it a drawing of?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Uhh... It was my sketch of Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, the one you drew when she went over to stay at your house that one time?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's it.
But there's no reason for it to be floating around inside this lake...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What if it's because your sketch has some sort of special place in Mafuyu's heart?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: This lake was born out of Mafuyu's feelings.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Seeing your sketch may've had some sort of effect on her. That might be why you're seeing it floating around now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: My sketch had an effect on her...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I was so sure that I had to keep getting better because I still didn't have what it takes. I thought I needed to give my future more thought...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if my sketch managed to find a way into Mafuyu's heart...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If my art had a real effect on her...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Then, that means my art has the ability to reach others...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, I need to keep improving little by little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ms. Yoisaki, I'm all done cleaning now.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I've also made enough food for two, so please feel free to eat it whenever you two like.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Thank you, Ms. Mochizuki.
I apologize for adding so much to your work order.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, please don't let that bother you.
I do get paid more for doing this.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, um... How is Asahina doing?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, she just fell asleep while working.
It's not like she isn't feeling well today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, I see. That's good to hear...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry!
I didn't mean to pry or anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Ms. Mochizuki was pretty startled when she learned that Mafuyu would be staying with me for a little while...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, she'll be staying with me for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Umm...
How long is “a little while”...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's hard for me to say. Days. Possibly longer...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Actually, she may end up staying here long term...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I can't divulge much more than that...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Something happened that led to her staying over at your house, yes...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, then I understand what I need to do.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'll do my best to make enough food for both you and Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Please feel free to let me know if you need anything, Asahina.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Quite a lot of time has passed since Mafuyu first came over...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (She seems okay whenever we're working together... But I've noticed her sinking from time to time.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I suppose it's only natural given her situation.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But isn't there anything else I can do for her...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (After speaking with Mafuyu's parents, and along with Ms. Mochizuki's help, she's been able to settle in nicely here.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Once things actually settle down...
She has to talk to her dad. And her mom.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (That's probably going to be incredibly painful for her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which is why I want to support her as best I can.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (And the only thing I can do for her right now is to keep composing.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Is that going to be enough to save her...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Listening to a song won't help resolve this situation. I can't save her from that person...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Huh? Luka...?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <It's about time for you to bring a demo over for us to listen to, but you haven't been around to SEKAI at all.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm still not happy with what I have.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. You don't have to answer now.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <If you do feel stuck, then why don't you come over for a visit? A strange, new area just appeared.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Yes. You haven't been there yet, right?
It may serve as good inspiration.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I'll be right back, Mafuyu.
I'm going to go take a quick look.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It doesn't quite fit into this SEKAI.
I'm sure you're going to be surprised.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It's one of yours, no?
You can hear it playing there from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Who knows? But you can tell while listening to it...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They must mean quite a lot to her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does this mean I've actually been helping her?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes...
I feel like this is evidence of that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I still haven't been able to save her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Right now, I feel that I need to figure out a way to do more for her besides just composing songs.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(What's she doing here?
No one besides us should be able to enter SEKAI...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But something must've happened to make her cry... I should try to help her...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Thank goodness she stopped crying for now...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Still... Is she lost...?
More importantly, how did she get here...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Um, so... Where did you come from?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
I was taking a nap...
But when I woke up, I saw that my plushie was gone and started looking for her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I still don't understand how she got here, but I should try to get her home as soon as possible...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But... How do I actually do that...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Would I be able to take her back by listening to Untitled...?
No, what if she wounds up somewhere unsafe instead...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Right. She said that she lost her plushie. I should help her find it.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Um, about your plushie...
Do you know where it might've gone?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Does this place not scare you at all...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah... This place felt scary at first...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But that music helped me feel better...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah, the music that's playing right now...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It feels so warm and cozy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh...
So, did you also hear it when you first woke up?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (If it was louder, then somewhere closer to the source may be where she woke up...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which means her plushie may also be waiting for us there.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Have you tried looking over there yet?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
This lake's beautiful. It's crystal clear...
But I'm not hearing any songs... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I see...
Then, let's try going over that way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, also... I'll try seeing if your plushie is somewhere around here. Give me one moment.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm not seeing her plushie anywhere...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Maybe this isn't the right place...
What if it's closer towards the lake...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Also, she can hear my song coming from the lake. Could there be a music player or something down there...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (What if her plushie fell into the lake...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Yes, I'm okay.
I'm going to keep looking for a little bit longer.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Going in doesn't seem safe...
But I may also find a clue...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But what I just saw...
If that was her plushie...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Just a little bit... Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
S-Sorry.
But I feel like I'm really close.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...? Where'd that shadow I just saw go...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: That's strange. I could've sworn it was just...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: I don't want you to get hurt because of me...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, I'm fine.
I did slip a little just now, but I'll be more careful...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: If she really is in that lake, then there's no point in you looking. I'm probably never gonna get her back...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There may be a way for us to look inside the lake. Even if she's not here, she could be somewhere else.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We still don't know where she might be... And I know finding her won't be easy.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean we can give up.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: If she's in the lake, then we'll find a way to save her.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, let's come up with a plan.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Thank you for everything you've done.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wait, I'm back in my room...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But how...?
Was that all a dream...?)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, no... I think I fell asleep just now is all.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
No, I just woke up.
I'll finish those lyrics now.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Okay, then I'll also continue working.
Would you mind letting me know when you're finished?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is the song I just heard in my dream...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Oh, was I singing just now...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I thought I just heard it in my dream just now...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I was lost in a place that I'd never been, and I was looking for something. I also felt very scared...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: And then I heard this song playing.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: That made me feel a little better...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Yeah, the music that's playing right now...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: It feels so warm and cozy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, that little girl kind of looked like Mafuyu...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Mafuyu, do you remember what it was that you were looking for in your dream...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. It's just that I happened to have a similar dream.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was helping a little girl look for her plushie...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (But if both Mafuyu and that girl felt that they needed to hear my song...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Okay. Thank you, Amia.
We should be able to upload it soon at the pace we're going.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Thank goodness!
I'm glad my decision to cut back a little on the effects ended up being a good idea!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<I'm of the same opinion.
This seems to go a lot better with the melody's overall feel.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, you think so?!
It must be pretty good if you like it that much, Enanan♪>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <While we're at it, Yuki, lemme hear what you think?! Do you like it?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Relax, will you... But I guess we can throw you a bone this time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <That reminds me. I've finished making a new demo, so I'd like for you to all listen to it...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <It's done? Then, let's listen to it with Miku and the others in SEKAI.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Yeah! Oh, also...
Do you all know about the new area that appeared in SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I already went!
You're talking about the big lake, right?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, that! It's so strange how you can hear one of K's songs playing from it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, um... I saw a place like that in a dream. A part of me is wondering if they're one and the same.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <So, I was helping a little girl look for her lost plushie... And we ended up by a lake together.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes. I'm not sure how else to describe it...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Interesting...
Then, let's go see if that's what you saw!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, does this mean your dream wasn't actually a dream?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Miku! You guys! You're all here too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We can easily pass the time here.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get that.
You can play in the lake and draw if you have a pen.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Can you bring us some next time, Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Come to think of it, this lake is kinda weird. I could've sworn that I saw something down there the last time I was here...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It might've been my imagination, but it definitely looked like one of my drawings...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Yeah, um...
That sketch of you, Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, Miku, that children's picture book you guys were reading also came from the lake, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And we can hear Kanade's song coming from it...
I've gotta think there's something else lurking around here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
Miku, how exactly did you guys get that book out of the lake?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have a feeling that only Mafuyu can take things out of it...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: She may be right. This lake was born out of Mafuyu's feelings, so it would make sense that only she would be able to fish anything out of there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, Mafuyu, wanna try grabbing something out of there?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you can't, then our hands are tied...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However, this may also be a clue regarding how we're supposed to find the real you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: This lake very likely contains some sort of manifestation of who you really are.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Finding that may be having to relive some painful memories.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Kanade's song coming from the lake, as well as the picture book about the rabbit... They both mean quite a lot to you, do they not?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Finding more of those things could be the key to uncovering your true self.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, you may find some things down there that you do not want to see again.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we'll be here if you do.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Your sketch of Mafuyu...!
I've seen pics of it before, but never the original.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Wow, it was really inside the lake.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
And it isn't even wet...
How does that work...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: This time, it's sheet music for N25...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And those ones are from ages ago!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I remember these...
They're from back when Mafuyu was doing all the mixing for us.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Back then, I tried to find my true self, but realized that I couldn't on my own...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I thought that making songs with you would help me achieve my goal, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There may be more hidden down there...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
(What is this...?
It's round and smooth...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what did you find this time?!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Can you sit up? You don't have to if you don't think you can.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line:
Then why don't we do this...?
Open up for the airplane...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Hehe. My, aren't we full of demands today.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Mother
rows.Line: Of course, dear. Now, lie down for me, and take my hand...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Looks like it.
But what does it mean?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Come to think of it, Mafuyu, I think I made apple sauce for you that one time you caught a cold...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It took me a little while since I didn't really know how to then, but I felt much better after you ate it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I don't want to think about what happened...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (But I can't seem to let go of this apple...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to do more for others...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I want to be right by their side when they're in pain...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (I... I think I need this to keep being me...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is that something important to you, Mafuyu?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure, but I think it is...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, you're right!
That wasn't there before, right?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
What's going on?
Should we go check it out?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hmm...
It looks like a regular door at first glance.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But was this door also born out of Mafuyu's feelings?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But why just a door...?
It's not like we can go anywhere by opening it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, it could be one of those doors that teleports us places!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Still, what could this door be for...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not sure, but it appearing has to mean something, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We may see further changes take place if your feelings were to continue evolving or transforming, Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Not unlike how this door just appeared.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I know...
Change is a scary thing...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean, it goes without saying that you disappearing would be a problem for us at this point.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's right. If anything frightening does happen, we'll be there to face it with you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Me too. Thank goodness Mafuyu's feeling a little better now...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Things are starting to change a little bit at a time.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Hey, you guys...
What's that by the lake...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: First this lake appears, and now we're seeing plants. Does this mean her feelings have undergone further changes?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: This could be a sign of things to come...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I hope it grows big and tall...

source: https://storage.sekai.best/sekai-en-assets/event_story/…（SEKAI master database + SEKAI Viewer 资源，官方文本）
